limitations: Every mapped allele and all 29 phenotype snapshots assessed. Complete main and all supplied supplementary components inspected. Exact transcript/GRCh38 mapping not independently verified; PAN2 causality remains explicitly a candidate-gene inference in this paper.

patient_identity.statement: Table S3 identifies 15DG2222 as a 34-month-old boy, matching male P2Y10M.

genotype.statement: The patient has a homozygous truncating PAN2 variant. Table S3 reports NM_001166279.1:c.3162delC:p.Ser1055Profs*4, while the packet uses another transcript and shifted residue numbering. Table S1 additionally gives NC_000012.11:g.56713209delG (hg19); no unverified conversion to the packet’s GRCh38 coordinate is asserted.
limitations: Exact equivalence to NM_014871.6:c.3153del / p.Ser1052ProfsTer4 needs a separate transcript/reference mapping.

segregation.statement: The PAN2 variant is within a run of homozygosity and reported to segregate within the family; parents are half first cousins and no similarly affected relatives are reported.
limitations: Individual parental genotype values are not printed in the inspected pedigree. Table S1 labels the PAN2 case Familial although Table S3 says no family history of a similar condition; label does not establish another affected relative.

phase.statement: A homozygous variant is reported, so two different candidate alleles do not require cis/trans resolution.
limitations: Homozygosity and within-family segregation reported; direct parental genotype values not printed.

causal_confidence.statement: PAN2 is explicitly a novel candidate gene supported by one mutational event; authors state that future cases are needed to confirm the gene–disease link.

evidence.locator: Lines 282–296 and 413–453; published pages 5 and 7, Discussion

limitations: The benchmark causal/solved label is stronger than the source’s tentative gene–disease inference. The RNase-domain effect and mouse analogy are not a functional assay of this patient allele.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Packet positives are largely supported by the detailed Table S3 case synopsis, but it omits imperforate anus, prolonged respiratory support, nail findings, retinal/macular findings, mild hypotonia and normal MRI.
limitations: Resolved cardiac defects and treated GERD are not current persistent disease claims.

assessment.statement: Homozygous truncating PAN2 is reported, but source NM_001166279.1:c.3162delC:p.Ser1055Profs*4 differs in transcript and numbering from packet NM_014871.6:c.3153del:p.Ser1052ProfsTer4.

evidence.locator: Table S1 page 2 PAN2 15DG2222: homozygous NM_001166279.1:c.3162delC; NC_000012.11:g.56713209delG

limitations: Exact transcript equivalence, GRCh38 g.56319426del and VCF normalization are unverified; no false allelic contradiction is asserted.
